svg.title: HESP framework overview
svg.desc: (a) The HESP decision loop: hypotheses, pre-registered predictions, diagnostic selection, execution, evidence ledger and state monitor around an LLM planner. (b) The authorized local sandbox with a hidden independent verifier. (c) Controlled three-arm evaluation and audit.
